name: Museo de la Ciudad de México
SOMA
known: Okón co-founded the earlier artist-run space La Panadería with Miguel Calderón and places SOMA in that tradition (Artillery, 2013).

name: Colección FEMSA
known: The curatorial team is Laura Pacheco, Paulina Bravo, Eugenia Braniff and Beto Díaz (CIMAM).

name: Museo Amparo
known: From 1871 part of the building was the home of Vicente Espinosa Bandini, grandfather of the founder (museum history page).
He became the largest shareholder and board president of Banco de Comercio (Bancomer) in 1958 and general director in 1959;

name: Fundación Casa Wabi
known: Founded by the Mexican artist Bosco Sodi, who has lived in New York for years (Forbes México, Carlos López Fe, "Él es el guerrillero del arte", 29 August 2016).
Casa Wabi thanks its sponsors with an undated page of logos and lists staff directors.

name: Centro Cultural Tijuana
known: The federal Secretaría de Cultura announced Miriam Gabriela García Aguirre as director on 14 March 2025 (Zeta).
A private board, the Patronato del CECUT, supports the centre; its board named in 2018 was chaired by Víctor A.
More than 250 Tijuana artists and writers boycotted the centre and its director Virgilio Muñoz for about three years, to 2011.

name: National Art Museum of Moldova
known: Wikipedia names the sculptor Alexandru Plămădeală and the painter Auguste Baillayre as founders and gives 26 November 1939 as the date.

Moldova's state budget funded restoration only unevenly: the then director, Tudor Zbârnea, said annual allocations ranged from 240,000 to 4 million, without naming the currency, and some were blocked (Europa Liberă, 2016).

name: Ulaanbaatar International Media Art Festival (UBIMAF)
known: Theme "Seeing is Believing", curated by the Berlin-based curator Inga Seidler (ASEF Culture360).

name: Zanabazar Museum of Fine Art
known: Wikipedia says it was proposed in 1965 by the chairman of the Mongolian Craftsmen's Union Committee and opened to the public on 23 July 1966.

name: Fondation Ifitry
known: The 6th Casablanca Biennale, conceived by the curator Marisa Caichiolo, runs from 10 December 2026 to 10 January 2027 in Essaouira and cites the Ifitry residency (Casablanca Biennale website).

name: LE 18, Derb el Ferrane

name: MACAAL
known: Founded by the private collector Othman Lazraq with his father Alami Lazraq.
MACAAL's site covers exhibitions, mission and visits; links its founder, Fondation Alliances.
